tools.name: create_flashcard_deck
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to learn, study, memorize, review, practice, or create flashcards about any topic. Generate the complete deck in this call and open it in the interactive flashcard UI. Act immediately using the existing conversation and source material; infer language and backLanguage you

tools.name: speak_text
tools.description: Use this when the flashcard widget requests speech audio for the current card.

tools.name: create_website_deck
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly asks to save or share a deck on the website, or chooses Learn on website in the study widget. It sends the supplied deck to Fulin Labs and creates a persistent shareable deck link. Anyone with the link can read the deck. Do not call merely to preview or study a deck

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_flashcard_deck" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user asks to learn, study, memorize, review, practice, or create flashcards about any topic. Generate the complete deck in this call and open …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_flashcard_deck · Public sink: create_flashcard_deck, create_website_deck · Destructive: create_flashcard_deck.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_flashcard_deck · Public sink: create_flashcard_deck, create_website_deck · Destructive: create_flashcard_deck

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
